title: R' Yosi bar Kesariy
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.4), he disagrees with Rabbi Tanchuma over “Of the sons of Issachar, who understood the times”: R' Yosi bar Kesariy says that this refers to calendar intercalations. The saying is repeated in Bamidbar Rabbah 13:16, where he is called only Rabbi Yosi, with bar Kesariy omitted. At the beginning of Esther Rabbah, chapter 4, the reading is Rabbi Yosi bar Katzrat, which should read bar Kesariy. In Bereshit Rabbah 22:14, Abba Yosi ben Kisri says, “He caused a horn to grow” (for Cain). See the entry R' Yosi of Kesari.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Kesariy (קסריי), Katzrat (קצרת) and Kisri (קיסרי) reproduce Hyman’s different name forms. Katzrat retains the resh in קצרת. The parenthetic reference to Cain is Hyman’s.

In the Torat Emet edition the Issachar saying is at [Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Bamidbar_Rabbah.13.15), rather than Hyman’s 13:16; the horn saying is at [Bereshit Rabbah 22:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.22.12), rather than 22:14, and names Abba Yosi ben Kesari.
